title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B, Part 1: Hexagon Head Bolts (Size Range M 1.6 to M 64)

regulatory_compliance.qco_order: Bolts, Nuts and Fasteners (Quality Control) Order, 2023

clause_1_scope: PART 1 HEXAGON HEAD BOLTS (SIZE RANGE M 1.6 TO M 64) ( Fourth Revision ) This International Standard specifies the characteristics of hexagon head bolts with threads from M1,6 up to and including M64, of product grade A for threads M1,6 to M24 and nominal lengths up to and including 10 ^ or 150 mm, whichever is shorter and product grade B for threads over M24 or nominal lengths over 10 ^ or 150 mm, whichever is shorter. If, in special cases, specifications other than those listed in this International Standard are required, they should be selected from existing International Standards, for example ISO 724, ISO 888, ISO 898-1, ISO 965-1, ISO 3506-1, ISO 4753 and ISO 4759-1.
